blocks.text: Grab, through Grab For Business, its enterprise platform for managing business rides, meals, and deliveries, today announced an integration with Concur Expense, SAP Concur’s expense management solution, to help organisations across Southeast Asia modernise the way they manage corporate travel and expenses. Through the integration, eligible Grab For Business transactions including business rides, meals, and deliveries are automatically captured in Concur Expense, reducing manual expense entry while helping organisations simplify expense reporting, strengthen policy compliance, and gain greater visibility and control over travel spending.
